ar.title: سلطة البطاطس

steps.n2: تسلق البطاطس بقشرها في ماء مغلي مملح حتى تنضج مع مراعاة ألا تتهرى.
steps.n4: في طبق عميق نعمل التتبيلة بمزج الزيت مع الملح والكمون، ثم يضاف عصير البصل والثوم المفري وعصير الليمون أو الخل ويقلبوا جيدا.
steps.n5: تقطع الطماطم قطعا متوسطة وكذا الفلفل الأخضر، ويقطع البقدونس صغيرا، ثم يضافون إلى التتبيلة ويخلطون جيدا.
steps.n6: توضع مكعبات البطاطس داخل الخلطة وتقلب جيدا.
steps.n8: نصائح عامة لحفظ الخضار: يُسلق الخضار المفروم للتجميد دقيقة واحدة في ماء مغلي مملح به قليل من الكربونات ثم يصفى فورا في ماء مثلج، ثم يجفف ويعبأ في أكياس محكمة الغلق داخل الفريزر لمدة لا تتجاوز 3 أشهر (ويسكب مباشرة في الشوربة الساخنة وهو مجمد). الملوخية تحفظ بعد فرمها بغمرها بمغرفة من الشوربة قبل التجميد. الخرشوف يحفظ في الثلاجة داخل ماء مغلي به زيت زيتون وعصير ليمون كثير. شرائح البطاطس تُسلق 3-4 دقائق ثم تبرد في ماء وخل قبل تجفيفها وتجميدها، وتُقلى وهي لا تزال مجمدة.

en.title: Potato Salad

steps.n1: Wash the potatoes thoroughly with their skins on.
steps.n2: Boil the potatoes in salted boiling water until tender, being careful not to let them become mushy.
steps.n3: Peel the potatoes and cut them into medium-sized cubes.
steps.n4: In a deep bowl, prepare the dressing by mixing the oil with salt and cumin, then add the onion juice, minced garlic, and lemon juice or vinegar, and mix well.
steps.n5: Chop the tomatoes and green peppers into medium pieces, finely chop the parsley, then add them to the dressing and mix well.
steps.n6: Add the potato cubes to the mixture and toss well.
steps.n7: Place in the refrigerator until serving time.
steps.n8: General tips for preserving vegetables: Blanch chopped vegetables for freezing by boiling them for one minute in salted water with a little baking soda, then immediately drain in ice water, dry, and pack in airtight bags in the freezer for no more than 3 months (pour directly into hot soup while frozen). To preserve molokhia, after chopping, submerge it in a ladle of broth before freezing. Artichokes are preserved in the refrigerator in boiled water with olive oil and plenty of lemon juice. Potato slices should be boiled for 3-4 minutes, then cooled in water and vinegar before drying and freezing; fry them while still frozen.

legacySteps: Wash the potatoes thoroughly with their skins on.
Boil the potatoes in salted boiling water until tender, being careful not to let them become mushy.
Peel the potatoes and cut them into medium-sized cubes.
In a deep bowl, prepare the dressing by mixing the oil with salt and cumin, then add the onion juice, minced garlic, and lemon juice or vinegar, and mix well.
Chop the tomatoes and green peppers into medium pieces, finely chop the parsley, then add them to the dressing and mix well.
Add the potato cubes to the mixture and toss well.
Place in the refrigerator until serving time.

General tips for preserving vegetables: Blanch chopped vegetables for freezing by boiling them for one minute in salted water with a little baking soda, then immediately drain in ice water, dry, and pack in airtight bags in the freezer for no more than 3 months (pour directly into hot soup while frozen). To preserve molokhia, after chopping, submerge it in a ladle of broth before freezing. Artichokes are preserved in the refrigerator in boiled water with olive oil and plenty of lemon juice. Potato slices should be boiled for 3-4 minutes, then cooled in water and vinegar before drying and freezing; fry them while still frozen.
